about.what: Per-country subscription prices for Singapore and Hong Kong, read on official pricing pages and App Store In-App Purchase lists. Same format as docs/research/prices-mena-2026-11.json.
about.amounts: amountMinor is in cents (SGD and HKD both have 2 decimals). 1998 = 19.98, HK$78 = 7800. Prices are the regular price after any free trial or intro offer. No row uses US dollars: every service checked bills both countries in local currency.

status.verified: Read today from the official page in 'source'.

about.taxes: Singapore GST is 9%. Hong Kong has no VAT or GST. Apple's prices include tax (its iCloud+ price list marks Singapore 'Taxes are included'). Most service pages don't say either way; each SG row's note says what the page says. Netflix's help page says taxes 'may be charged in addition'.
about.serviceIds: serviceId and plan ids come from plan-ref (same plan = same id in every country). 'student' for Spotify is not in plan-ref; it matches the MENA file.
about.method: Service pages read with curl from a US cloud IP using the country URL (e.g. spotify.com/sg-en/premium, help.netflix.com/en/node/24926/hk); Xbox pages rendered with Playwright (chromium). App Store lists read from apps.apple.com/{cc}/app/id{ID}?l=en-GB (Apple shows at most 10 items). Where one name has two different prices with no period and no 6x gap, the service is left in notChecked.
